mapper.select:
WITH processBusiness AS ( select distinct business_key from process_business where is_deleted = false and process_definition_id = #{processDefinitionId} ) select
from process_delegate pd inner join processBusiness pb on pb.business_key = pd.business_key where pd.is_deleted = false and pd.status in ('pending','running') and now() >= pd.effective_time and pd.expire_time > now()
